what: When the next button is pressed, paper in the card’s current background color spreads out from the bottom-left corner with a radius = The paper wraps around a cylinder with a radius of card width × .16 and curls diagonally, flipping over in 1.25s power2.inOut (curled inner side darker, back side 15% brighter), revealing the new panel below (is-flipped). In the last .2s the paper fades away. When you hover the button, the same paper lifts only at the corner by .1 over .52s power2.out so the next panel peeks out (is-peek), and it settles back when you release (WebGL·OGL).

options.peek: Curl progress when peeking (0–1), default .1 — 0 means no peek
options.radius: Cylinder radius (share of card width), default .16
options.corner: Corner where curling starts: bl·br·tl·tr, default bl

use:
Monthly fee
Annual rate
— card colors are set by the css that uses it, on .is-flipped (after the flip) and .is-peek (next sheet visible underneath when peeking). To flip from an outside button, el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("fx:flip"))

from.where: index.js paperGL — pricing card (.pricing_sheet): pressing the monthly/yearly toggle rolls a lime ↔ sky paper over from the bottom left, and hovering the toggle lifts a corner (original paper.js: duration 1.25 · peekAt .52 · radius 110→ · corner top-left (GL coordinates, so the bottom left of the screen))

note: The original has an extra stage where the paper is lifted by wind (gust·windLift) and flies off, while this part only does the cylinder curl. If the card has overflow: hidden the curled paper gets clipped, so put it on an outer wrapper. With reduced motion, only the sheet is swapped
